attempts.raw_response: Tap Next. On the next screen, you'll be asked to choose a username. This will be your channel's handle, so pick something memorable and relevant to your content. Type it into the text box, then tap Next again. You'll now see a screen where you can upload a profile picture. Tap the camera icon to choose a photo from your gallery or take a new one. After that, tap Next. Finally, review your details and tap Create channel. Your new YouTube channel is now ready. You can customize it further by adding a description and links to your other social media.

pair.human_continuation: Select the month, day, and year of your birthday, then tap the "Gender" box and select your gender.  You can't use an existing, non-Gmail address to create a Google Account through the YouTube app, so you'll need to create a new Gmail address by typing whatever you want to use for your Gmail address' username into the "Username" text box.  For example, typing in "iamabanana" here will set your Gmail address to "iamabanana@gmail.com". When creating a YouTube account on mobile, you'll have to create a Gmail account rather than using a separate email address. If you want to use a non-Gmail address, use the YouTube website to create your YouTube account.  Type your preferred password into the "Create password" text box, then repeat the password in the "Confirm password" text box.

This option is near the bottom of the screen. Type your first name into the "First name" text box, then type your last name into the "Last name" text box. It's a blue button at the bottom of the page.
